Eckhardt (2005) two-parameter recursive digital filter

Source: R/baseflow.R
baseflow_eckhardt.Rd

b[t] = ((1 - BFImax) a b[t-1] + (1 - a) BFImax q[t]) / (1 - a BFImax), constrained to 0 <= b[t] <= q[t]. NA discharge carries the previous baseflow forward and returns NA for that day.

Usage

baseflow_eckhardt(q, alpha = 0.98, bfi_max = 0.8, bf_0 = NULL)

Arguments

q

Daily discharge (any units).

alpha

Recession constant (typically 0.95-0.99).

bfi_max

Maximum baseflow index: ~0.80 perennial/porous aquifers, ~0.50 ephemeral, ~0.25 perennial hard-rock (Eckhardt 2005).

bf_0

Initial baseflow; default q[1] * bfi_max.

Value

Tibble: q, baseflow, quickflow.
